methodology.universe: ETF portfolio holdings as proxies, not complete or licensed index membership.
methodology.weights: Percent of each source ETF. Values are comparable only within the same fund, not across funds.
methodology.size: Russell 1000/2000 mapped by ETF overlaps; Top 200 is estimated by holdings market-value rank.
methodology.industry: Yahoo Finance metadata for companies with successful, cached enrichment; otherwise Unclassified.
methodology.returns: Yahoo Finance adjusted ETF close returns; benchmarks reflect ETF proxies, not stock-level performance.
methodology.coverage: Funds may sample constituents; derivative/cash exposures excluded. No claim of global exhaustiveness.
